title: Design System: Browser agent routing benchmark

body.purpose: Default copy, controls, and supporting text.

components.name: Primary action
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 17px; border: 1px solid transparent; color: #fff; background: #174fb5; font: 700 13px system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #103b88; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b5ce2d; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .5; }

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: Cancels or refreshes without starting a run.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 17px; border: 1px solid #c9d5e5; color: #14254a; background: #fbfdff; font: 700 13px system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: #edf3fb; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b5ce2d; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Workspace panel
components.description: Groups the current run, report details, or saved reports.
components.css: .ds-panel { min-width: 0; padding: 19px 20px 15px; border: 1px solid #c9d5e5; color: #14254a; background: #fbfdff; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0; font: 700 15px system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-panel p { margin: 5px 0 0; color: #51617b; font: 12px system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }

components.name: Matrix measurement cell
components.description: Shows a benchmark cell state and its measured metadata.
components.css: .ds-matrix-cell { display: grid; gap: 5px; color: #19734a; font: 12px/1.3 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-matrix-cell::before { content: ''; display: block; width: 28px; height: 6px; background: linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor) left top / 100% 1px no-repeat, repeating-linear-gradient(to right, currentColor 0 1px, transparent 1px 7px) left top / 100% 5px no-repeat; } .ds-matrix-cell strong { font-weight: 750; } .ds-matrix-cell span { color: #51617b; } .ds-matrix-cell:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b5ce2d; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Saved report entry
components.description: Selects a saved benchmark report for inspection.
components.css: .ds-report-entry { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 14px 18px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #e0e7f0; color: #14254a; background: #edf3fc; box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 #174fb5; text-align: left; font: 12px system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-report-entry:hover { background: #f3f7fc; } .ds-report-entry:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b5ce2d; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-report-entry strong { font-weight: 750; } .ds-report-entry span { float: right; color: #51617b; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.northStar: Inferred direction: scientific data plates. The user approved project scope and left visual direction open; this is not a user-confirmed creative North Star.
narrative.overview:
The playground is a measurement workspace for browser strategy experiments. Its visual direction uses the language of scientific data plates: an ice-white work surface, a cobalt shell, ink navy text, and citron for selection. This direction was inferred from the benchmark's measurement and comparison needs after the user approved project scope and left visual direction open. It is not a user-confirmed creative North Star.

Outcomes use semantic color, while timing and usage use tabular numerals. Small measurement ticks connect completed matrix cells to their result and duration. Use standard web controls and tables so the dense comparison stays familiar. No raster assets are part of the system.

The finish review resolved its only reported material progress finding, which covered the listed live-progress fix. No paid matrix was run, so the interface records no paid benchmark measurements.

rules.name: The Outcome Color Rule
rules.body: Green and red communicate verified pass and fail outcomes. Amber is reserved for warnings. Do not use these colors as general decoration.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: Numeric values that users compare align with tabular numerals. Keep monospace limited to identifiers and code.

rules.name: The Square Form Rule
rules.body: Keep panels, buttons, tags, and selection marks square-edged. Do not add rounded card styling.

dos: Do use cobalt for navigation, primary actions, and active progress.
Do use citron for active selection and keyboard focus.
Do keep result, timing, and usage values aligned in a dense grid.
Do preserve reduced-motion behavior for transitions.
donts: Don't use success or failure colors for decoration.
Don't replace the system UI font with a display face.
Don't add raster imagery or rounded card treatments.
Don't imply measured performance where a paid matrix has not run.
